events.title: Mo's 7th Birthday featuring Peach Fur
events.description: An energetic live music event at one of the Gold Coast's most authentic indie venues, celebrating their 7th anniversary with Peach Fur and local support acts. This venue is known for its creative atmosphere and community-focused music culture.

events.title: Candlelight Concerts - Imperial Hotel Gold Coast
events.description: An intimate, atmospheric concert series featuring classical performances staged in a candlelit venue. The environment is designed to foster a focused and appreciative listening experience.
